suspensionGuide.title: Suspension guide
suspensionGuide.subtitle: How a suspension task affects the process and semaphore
suspensionGuide.bannerText: There are suspension tasks in this list. Those processes stay Suspended and the inactivity semaphore remains paused until you complete or remove the task.
suspensionGuide.badgeTip: This task suspends the process. Completing it or moving it to trash reactivates it. Tap to open the guide.
suspensionGuide.whatDesc: Creating or updating a Suspension task (pending or draft) sets the process to Suspended and pauses the inactivity semaphore. General tasks do not change process status.
suspensionGuide.create2: Only one active suspension (pending or draft) is allowed per process.
suspensionGuide.create3: The process becomes Suspended and keeps syncing proceedings.
suspensionGuide.reactivate2: Or move the task to trash.
suspensionGuide.reactivate3: There is no «cancelled» status: only complete or trash reactivates.
suspensionGuide.semaphoreProcess: Process: while suspended, the inactivity semaphore is paused (no green/yellow/red) and no inactivity alerts are raised.
suspensionGuide.semaphoreTask: Task: the Agenda urgency semaphore still uses due date thresholds (10 / 15 / 30 days), including suspension tasks.
suspensionGuide.process2: You cannot toggle Active/Inactive from the menu: resolve the suspension in the Agenda.
suspensionGuide.process3: Possible process states: Active, Inactive, or Suspended.
